cards.en: If an animal had to pretend to be you for a day, which animal would do it best, and why?
cards.hi: Agar ek din ke liye kisi janwar ko aap banna pade, toh kaunsa janwar ye sabse achha karega, aur kyun?

cards.en: What is the silliest thing you believed was true when you were younger?
cards.hi: Bachpan mein aapne kaunsi sabse silly baat sach maan li thi?

cards.en: If you could invent a brand-new celebration day, what would everyone do on that day?
cards.hi: Agar aap ek bilkul naya celebration day bana sakein, toh us din sabko kya karna hoga?

cards.en: What food did you dislike when you were smaller, but enjoy now?
cards.hi: Bachpan mein kaunsa khana aapko bilkul pasand nahi tha, par ab achha lagta hai?

cards.en: What is one thing you have taught someone older than you?
cards.hi: Aapne apne se bade kisi insaan ko kya sikhaya hai?

cards.en: If one object in your home could talk, which one would tell the funniest stories about you?
cards.hi: Agar ghar ki koi ek cheez bol paati, toh kaunsi cheez aapke baare mein sabse funny kisse sunati?

cards.en: What is the most useless superpower you would still love to have?
cards.hi: Sabse useless superpower kaunsi hai jo aapko phir bhi chahiye?

cards.en: What is one small thing you are secretly very good at?
cards.hi: Kaunsi chhoti si cheez aapko secretly bahut achhe se aati hai?

cards.en: Have you ever pretended to be asleep to avoid doing something? What was it?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi koi kaam taalne ke liye sone ka natak kiya hai? Kaunsa kaam tha?

cards.en: What is the funniest thing you have ever seen an animal do?
cards.hi: Aapne kisi janwar ko sabse funny kya karte dekha hai?

cards.en: If you could make one new rule that everyone in your home must follow, what would it be?
cards.hi: Agar aap ghar ke liye ek naya rule bana sakein jo sabko maanna pade, toh woh kya hoga?

cards.en: Which cartoon or story character is most like you, and why?
cards.hi: Kaunsa cartoon ya kahani ka character bilkul aapke jaisa hai, aur kyun?

cards.en: What word did you say in a funny, wrong way when you were little?
cards.hi: Bachpan mein aapne kaunsa word hamesha funny, galat tarike se bola?

cards.en: If you became as small as an ant for one hour, where would you explore first?
cards.hi: Agar ek ghante ke liye aapka size cheenti jitna ho jaaye, toh aapko sabse pehle kahan ghoomna hai?

cards.en: What is the best gift you have ever made or given to someone?
cards.hi: Aapka banaya ya diya hua sabse best gift kaunsa tha?

cards.en: Who here makes you laugh the most, and how do they do it?
cards.hi: Yahan aapko sabse zyada kaun hasata hai, aur kaise?

cards.en: What is the messiest thing you have ever done in the kitchen?
cards.hi: Kitchen mein aapne ab tak sabse badi gadbad kya ki hai?

cards.en: Which household job do you secretly enjoy, and which one would you happily stop doing forever?
cards.hi: Ghar ka kaunsa kaam aapko chupke se pasand hai, aur kaunsa kaam hamesha ke liye chhod dena aapko achha lagega?

cards.en: What is something you were sure you could do, but it went completely wrong?
cards.hi: Kaunsa kaam aapko pakka lagta tha ki ho jaayega, par poora ulta pad gaya?

cards.en: If you opened your own shop, what would you sell, and what would you name it?
cards.hi: Agar aapki apni dukaan ho, toh usmein kya bikega aur dukaan ka naam kya hoga?

cards.en: What is the longest time you have spent searching for something that was right in front of you?
cards.hi: Saamne padi kisi cheez ko dhoondhne mein aapne sabse zyada kitna time lagaya hai?

cards.en: Have you ever laughed when you were supposed to stay quiet, like in class? What happened?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi aapko aisi jagah hasi aayi jahan chup rehna tha, jaise class mein? Kya hua tha?

cards.en: If you had to eat food of only one colour for a whole day, which colour would you choose?
cards.hi: Agar poore din sirf ek hi rang ka khana khana pade, toh aapko kaunsa rang chahiye?

cards.en: If you had a robot helper, what is the first job you would give it?
cards.hi: Agar aapke paas ek robot helper ho, toh use sabse pehle kaunsa kaam milega?

cards.en: Which game do you always think you will win, but usually lose?
cards.hi: Kaunse game mein aapko hamesha jeet pakki lagti hai, par aksar haar hoti hai?

cards.en: Walk like a penguin across the room and back, flapping your arms like little wings.
cards.hi: Penguin ki tarah room ke us paar jaaiye aur waapas aaiye, haathon ko chhote pankhon ki tarah hilaate hue.

cards.en: Say 'Sixty shiny ships sail slowly south' three times fast without making a mistake.
cards.hi: 'Sixty shiny ships sail slowly south' teen baar jaldi-jaldi boliye, bina koi galti kiye.

cards.en: Be a news reader and give today's weather report in a very dramatic voice.
cards.hi: News reader baniye aur bahut dramatic awaaz mein aaj ka weather report sunaiye.

cards.en: Lead a silly dance for 20 seconds while everyone else copies every move you make.
cards.hi: 20 second tak ek silly dance kariye, aur baaki sab aapka har move copy karein.

cards.en: Start a funny story with one sentence; each player adds one sentence until it comes back to you.
cards.hi: Ek line se funny kahani shuru kariye; phir har player ek-ek line jode, jab tak baari waapas aap tak na aaye.

cards.en: Invent a new team greeting without touching, using a special wave and a sound, then teach it to everyone.
cards.hi: Bina chhuye ek naya team greeting banaiye, ek special wave aur ek awaaz ke saath, phir sabko sikhaiye.

cards.en: For 30 seconds, the group asks you questions and you must answer every one by singing.
cards.hi: 30 second tak group aapse sawaal poochega, aur aapko har jawab gaakar dena hai.

cards.en: Say 'Brave blue birds bring bread back' five times fast.
cards.hi: 'Kaccha papad, pakka papad' paanch baar jaldi-jaldi boliye.

cards.en: Introduce the person on your left as if they are a superstar, giving them a kind title like 'Champion of Smiles'.
cards.hi: Apne left wale player ko superstar ki tarah introduce kariye, aur unhe 'Muskaan ka Champion' jaisa pyaara title dijiye.

cards.en: Turn into an elephant: use one arm as your trunk and make a loud elephant sound.
cards.hi: Haathi ban jaaiye: ek haath ko soond banaiye aur zor se haathi ki awaaz nikaaliye.

cards.en: In slow motion, act out hitting the winning shot in a big match, then celebrate in slow motion too.
cards.hi: Slow motion mein bade match ka winning shot maarke dikhaiye, phir slow motion mein hi celebrate kariye.

cards.en: Tell everyone what you did today in the voice of a very excited puppy.
cards.hi: Ek bahut excited puppy ki awaaz mein sabko bataiye ki aapne aaj kya kiya.

cards.en: Draw something in this room on paper with your eyes closed, then let everyone guess what it is.
cards.hi: Aankhein band karke room ki koi cheez paper par banaiye, phir sabko guess karne dijiye ki woh kya hai.

cards.en: Pretend to be an ice cream melting on a hot day, slowly sinking down to the floor.
cards.hi: Garmi ke din pighalti ice cream ban jaaiye, aur dheere-dheere neeche zameen tak aa jaaiye.

cards.en: Laugh in four different ways: a tiny laugh, a loud laugh, a villain laugh and a silent laugh.
cards.hi: Chaar tarah se hass ke dikhaiye: chhoti si hasi, zor ki hasi, villain wali hasi aur bina awaaz wali hasi.

cards.en: Name ten different fruits in 20 seconds without repeating any.
cards.hi: 20 second mein das alag-alag phalon ke naam boliye, koi bhi repeat nahi hona chahiye.

cards.en: Pretend you own a fancy restaurant and take everyone's food order in a funny voice.
cards.hi: Maan lijiye aapka ek fancy restaurant hai; ek funny awaaz mein sabka food order lijiye.

cards.en: Be a tour guide and describe this room as if it were a famous museum.
cards.hi: Tour guide baniye aur is room ko aise describe kariye jaise ye koi famous museum ho.

cards.en: Give everyone an animal sound. For 20 seconds, point at players faster and faster; whoever you point at makes their sound.
cards.hi: Sabko ek janwar ki awaaz dijiye. 20 second tak tez-tez players ki taraf point kariye; jis par point ho, woh apni awaaz nikaale.

cards.en: Build a tower of five unbreakable things, like books or cushions, using only one hand in 30 seconds.
cards.hi: 30 second mein sirf ek haath se paanch na tootne wali cheezon ka tower banaiye, jaise books ya cushions.

cards.en: Give a 15-second thank-you speech for winning the 'World's Best Sleeper' award.
cards.hi: 'World's Best Sleeper' award jeetne par 15 second ki thank-you speech dijiye.

cards.en: Show us how a cat would act if it had to take a bath.
cards.hi: Dikhaiye ki agar billi ko nahana pade toh woh kya karegi.

cards.en: Act like a car stuck in heavy traffic, making every horn and engine sound you can.
cards.hi: Bhaari traffic mein phasi car ban jaaiye, aur jitni ho sake utni horn aur engine ki awaazein nikaaliye.

cards.en: Sing any song you know, but replace every word with 'banana'.
cards.hi: Koi bhi gaana gaaiye, par har word ki jagah 'banana' boliye.

cards.en: Act out your favourite hobby without speaking; the group has 30 seconds to guess it.
cards.hi: Bina bole apni favourite hobby act karke dikhaiye; group ke paas guess karne ke liye 30 second hain.

cards.en: Would you rather have a pet dragon the size of a cat, or a pet cat the size of a dragon?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: billi jitna chhota pet dragon, ya dragon jitni badi pet billi?

cards.en: Would you rather understand what birds are saying, or what babies are saying?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: chidiyon ki baatein samajhna, ya chhote babies ki baatein samajhna?

cards.en: Would you rather have a slide from your bed to the kitchen, or a garden that grows toys?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: bed se kitchen tak ek slide, ya ek garden jismein khilone ugte hain?

cards.en: Would you rather always hop instead of walking, or always sing instead of talking?
cards.hi: Kya behtar hai: hamesha kood-kood ke chalna, ya hamesha gaa-gaa ke baat karna?

cards.en: Would you rather have a pencil that makes drawings come alive, or a spoon that makes any food appear?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: aisi pencil jisse drawing zinda ho jaaye, ya aisa chammach jisse koi bhi khana aa jaaye?

cards.en: Would you rather live for a month on a boat, or in a tree house?
cards.hi: Kya behtar hai: ek mahina boat par rehna, ya ek mahina tree house mein?

cards.en: Would you rather have a bicycle that can talk, or a flying carpet that moves very slowly?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: baat karne wali cycle, ya bahut dheere udne wala jaadui carpet?

cards.en: Would you rather be the main character in a video game, or in a fairy tale?
cards.hi: Kya behtar hai: kisi video game ka main character banna, ya kisi pariyon ki kahani ka?

cards.en: Never have I ever talked to a plant or a toy and waited for an answer.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi kisi paudhe ya khilone se baat karke jawab ka intezaar nahi kiya.

cards.en: Never have I ever worn something inside out for hours without noticing.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi bina notice kiye ghanton tak kuch ulta nahi pehna.

cards.en: Never have I ever fallen asleep in a really funny place.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi kisi bahut funny jagah par jhapki nahi li.

cards.en: Never have I ever invented my own secret language or code.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi apni khud ki secret language ya code nahi banaya.

cards.en: Never have I ever added salt instead of sugar to something by mistake.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi galti se cheeni ki jagah namak nahi daala.

cards.en: Never have I ever built a tent out of blankets or bedsheets to play inside.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi khelne ke liye kambal ya chaadar se tent nahi banaya.

cards.en: Never have I ever waved back at someone who was actually waving at the person behind me.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi kisi ki taraf haath nahi hilaya jo asal mein mere peeche wale ko wave kar raha tha.

cards.en: Never have I ever sung a song with the wrong words for years without knowing.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi saalon tak bina jaane kisi gaane ke galat lyrics nahi gaaye.

cards.en: Who is most likely to invent a new ice cream flavour that everyone loves?
cards.hi: Kiske aisa naya ice cream flavour banane ke chances sabse zyada hain jo sabko pasand aaye?

cards.en: Who is most likely to laugh at their own joke before finishing it?
cards.hi: Kiske apna joke poora karne se pehle hi khud hasne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to win a dance competition with a move nobody has ever seen?
cards.hi: Kiske aise naye dance move se competition jeetne ke chances sabse zyada hain jo kisi ne kabhi nahi dekha?

cards.en: Who is most likely to become a famous explorer and discover a new island?
cards.hi: Kiske famous explorer bankar naya island dhoondhne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to try to fix everything at home with sticky tape?
cards.hi: Kiske ghar ki har cheez cello tape se theek karne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to win a staring contest with a cat?
cards.hi: Kiske billi se staring contest jeetne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to cheer everyone up on a bad day?
cards.hi: Kiske bure din par sabka mood theek karne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to turn a boring job into a fun game?
cards.hi: Kiske boring kaam ko bhi mazedaar game banane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: What is the funniest dream you can remember?
cards.hi: Aapne ab tak ka sabse funny sapna kaunsa dekha hai?

cards.en: If you had a pet cloud, what would you name it, and what tricks would it do?
cards.hi: Agar aapke paas ek pet baadal ho, toh uska naam kya hoga aur woh kaunse tricks dikhayega?

cards.en: If you could add one new subject at school, what would you learn in it?
cards.hi: Agar aap school mein ek naya subject jod sakein, toh usmein kya padhaya jaayega?

cards.en: What is the best thing about being your age right now?
cards.hi: Abhi aapki jo umar hai, uski sabse achhi baat kya hai?

cards.en: What is your favourite sound in the whole world?
cards.hi: Poori duniya mein aapki favourite awaaz kaunsi hai?

cards.en: If you could shrink and live inside a board game for a day, which game would it be?
cards.hi: Agar ek din ke liye kisi board game ke andar rehne ka mauka mile, toh woh kaunsa game hoga?

cards.en: What is the kindest thing someone here has ever done for you?
cards.hi: Yahan kisi ne aapke liye ab tak sabse pyaari cheez kya ki hai?

cards.en: What is the best story a grandparent or older relative has told you?
cards.hi: Nani, dadi, nana, dada ya ghar ke kisi bade ne aapko sabse achhi kahani kaunsi sunayi hai?

cards.en: Which festival do you look forward to most, and what is your favourite part of it?
cards.hi: Aapko kis tyohaar ka sabse zyada intezaar rehta hai, aur usmein sabse achha kya lagta hai?

cards.en: If any animal could be your classmate, which one would sit next to you?
cards.hi: Agar koi janwar aapka classmate ban sake, toh aapke bagal mein kaunsa janwar baithega?

cards.en: What is your happiest memory from a summer holiday?
cards.hi: Garmi ki chhuttiyon ki aapki sabse pyaari yaad kaunsi hai?

cards.en: What is something that felt hard at first but is easy for you now?
cards.hi: Aisa kaunsa kaam hai jo pehle mushkil lagta tha, par ab aapke liye aasaan hai?

cards.en: If you were a kitchen tool, like a spoon or a rolling pin, which one would you be?
cards.hi: Agar aapko kitchen ki koi cheez banna pade, jaise chammach ya belan, toh woh kaunsi hogi?

cards.en: What is the funniest thing a baby or small child has done in front of you?
cards.hi: Kisi baby ya chhote bachche ne aapke saamne sabse funny kya kiya hai?

cards.en: If you could try any job for one day, like pilot, chef or train driver, which one would you pick?
cards.hi: Agar aap ek din ke liye koi bhi job try kar sakein, jaise pilot, chef ya train driver, toh woh kaunsi job hogi?
cards.edited: too many animal truths; overlapped talking-animal cards

cards.en: What is the coolest thing you have ever built with blocks, sand or cardboard?
cards.hi: Blocks, ret ya cardboard se aapne ab tak sabse cool cheez kya banayi hai?

cards.en: What is the best thing you have ever won, like a prize, a medal or a game?
cards.hi: Aapne ab tak sabse best cheez kya jeeti hai, jaise koi prize, medal ya game?

cards.en: What is your favourite thing to do on a rainy day?
cards.hi: Baarish wale din aapko sabse zyada kya karna pasand hai?

cards.en: Which animal would you love to ride on, and where would you go?
cards.hi: Aapko kis janwar ki sawaari karni hai, aur uspar baith ke kahan jaana hai?

cards.en: Which song, Bollywood or any other, makes you want to dance wherever you are?
cards.hi: Kaunsa gaana, Bollywood ya koi aur, sunte hi aapka kahin bhi naachne ka mann karta hai?

cards.en: Have you ever helped an animal that needed help? What did you do?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi musibat mein phase kisi janwar ki madad ki hai? Kya kiya tha?

cards.en: If your school bag had one magic pocket, what would it do?
cards.hi: Agar aapke school bag mein ek magic pocket ho, toh woh kya karegi?

cards.en: Which skill would you love an older family member to teach you?
cards.hi: Ghar ke kisi bade se aapko kaunsi skill seekhni hai?

cards.en: What is the most fun you have had on a long train, bus or car trip?
cards.hi: Lambi train, bus ya car journey mein aapko sabse zyada maza kab aaya?

cards.en: What is your best idea for a brand-new playground ride?
cards.hi: Playground ke ek bilkul naye jhoole ke liye aapka best idea kya hai?

cards.en: What is something you are proud of doing this year?
cards.hi: Is saal aapne aisa kya kiya jis par aapko proud feel hota hai?

cards.en: If you could ask the moon one question, what would you ask?
cards.hi: Agar aap chanda mama se ek sawaal pooch sakein, toh woh sawaal kya hoga?

cards.en: If you could build a home anywhere, like under the sea or on a rainbow, where would it be?
cards.hi: Agar aap kahin bhi ghar bana sakein, jaise samundar ke neeche ya rainbow par, toh woh kahan hoga?

cards.en: Which sport, like cricket or football, would you love to play with a famous champion, and why?
cards.hi: Kaunsa sport, jaise cricket ya football, aapko kisi famous champion ke saath khelna hai, aur kyun?

cards.en: If you could mix two animals into one new pet, which two would you pick?
cards.hi: Agar do janwaron ko milaakar ek naya pet ban sake, toh woh kaunse do janwar honge?

cards.en: What is your favourite smell, like rain, fresh bread or new books?
cards.hi: Aapki favourite khushboo kaunsi hai, jaise baarish ki mitti, garam roti ya nayi books?

cards.en: What would you dress up as for a school fancy dress competition?
cards.hi: School ke fancy dress competition ke liye aapka costume kya hoga?

cards.en: If you found a new planet, what is the first thing you would build there?
cards.hi: Agar aapko ek naya planet mil jaaye, toh wahan sabse pehle kya banega?

cards.en: What is your favourite thing to do when the lights go off in a power cut?
cards.hi: Light jaane par aapko sabse zyada kya karna pasand hai?

cards.en: What is the funniest mistake you have made while trying to help at home?
cards.hi: Ghar mein help karte-karte aapse sabse funny galti kya hui hai?

cards.en: What is one thing you really like about the player on your right?
cards.hi: Aapke right wale player ki kaunsi baat aapko sabse achhi lagti hai?

cards.en: If it could rain anything for one day, what would you want to fall from the sky?
cards.hi: Agar ek din aasmaan se kuch bhi baras sake, toh aapko kya chahiye?

cards.en: If you could have a never-ending supply of one thing, like crayons or stickers, what would it be?
cards.hi: Agar aapko kisi ek cheez ka kabhi khatam na hone wala stock mile, jaise crayons ya stickers, toh woh kya hogi?

cards.en: What is the best hiding spot you have ever found in hide and seek?
cards.hi: Chhupan-chhupai mein aapki ab tak ki sabse best chhupne ki jagah kaunsi thi?

cards.en: Which bedtime story would you love to hear again and again?
cards.hi: Sone se pehle ki kaunsi kahani aapko baar-baar sunni hai?

cards.en: If you planned a birthday party with any theme at all, what would the theme be?
cards.hi: Agar aapko kisi bhi theme ki birthday party plan karni ho, toh theme kya hogi?

cards.en: What is one grown-up job at home you cannot wait to be allowed to do?
cards.hi: Ghar ka kaunsa bado wala kaam karne ki permission aapko jaldi se jaldi chahiye?

cards.en: If you could make one toy that does not exist yet, what would it do?
cards.hi: Agar aap ek aisa khilona bana sakein jo abhi tak duniya mein nahi hai, toh woh kya karega?

cards.en: Pretend you are an astronaut floating in space, trying to catch a toy that keeps floating away.
cards.hi: Space mein tairte astronaut ki acting kariye: ek khilona baar-baar door tair jaata hai, aur aapko use pakadna hai.
cards.edited: third 'walk like an animal across the room' dare; repetitive

cards.en: Roar like a big lion, then like a lion with a cold, then like a tiny baby lion.
cards.hi: Pehle bade sher ki tarah dahaadiye, phir zukaam wale sher ki tarah, phir chhote baby sher ki tarah.

cards.en: Try to balance a spoon on one finger for 10 seconds.
cards.hi: 10 second tak ek ungli par chammach balance karke dikhaiye.

cards.en: Make three different animal faces, one by one; the group guesses each animal.
cards.hi: Ek-ek karke teen alag janwaron ke face banaiye; group har janwar guess karega.

cards.en: Make a funny face. The player on your left copies it and adds one silly change.
cards.hi: Ek funny face banaiye. Aapke left wala player use copy kare aur usmein ek silly change jode.

cards.en: Strut like a proud chicken on a fashion show ramp, then strike your best pose.
cards.hi: Fashion show ke ramp par ek proud murgi ki tarah chal ke dikhaiye, phir apna best pose dijiye.

cards.en: Write your first name in the air with your elbow while everyone guesses each letter.
cards.hi: Kohni se hawa mein apna pehla naam likhiye, aur sab har letter guess karein.

cards.en: Act like a washing machine, from filling with water to the fast spin at the end.
cards.hi: Washing machine ban jaaiye: paani bharne se lekar aakhir ke fast spin tak sab karke dikhaiye.

cards.en: Act like a pressure cooker slowly heating up, then give three loud whistles.
cards.hi: Pressure cooker ban jaaiye: pehle dheere-dheere garam hone ki acting kariye, phir zor se teen seeti maariye.

cards.en: Hum a cartoon theme song; the group has 20 seconds to guess the cartoon.
cards.hi: Kisi cartoon ka theme song gungunaiye; group ke paas cartoon guess karne ke liye 20 second hain.

cards.en: Do a 'magic trick' with any object, say a magic word, and take a big bow.
cards.hi: Kisi bhi cheez se ek 'magic trick' dikhaiye, 'Gilli gilli chhoo' jaisa magic word boliye, aur jhuk ke bow kariye.

cards.en: Make up a short song about your favourite animal and sing it with actions.
cards.hi: Apne favourite janwar par ek chhota sa gaana banaiye aur actions ke saath gaaiye.

cards.en: Act like a kite flying high on a windy day, then getting stuck in a tree.
cards.hi: Tez hawa mein oonchi udti patang ban jaaiye, jo phir ek ped mein atak jaati hai.

cards.en: Name an animal for every letter from A to J in 30 seconds.
cards.hi: 30 second mein A se J tak har letter se ek janwar ka naam boliye.

cards.en: Pretend to be a baby bird trying to fly for the very first time.
cards.hi: Ek baby chidiya ban jaaiye jo pehli baar udna seekh rahi hai.

cards.en: Wear a cushion like a crown and give a short royal speech as the ruler of Pillow Land.
cards.hi: Cushion ko taaj ki tarah sar par rakhiye aur 'Takiya Desh' ke ruler bankar ek chhoti si royal speech dijiye.

cards.en: Be a traffic officer: direct the group with your hands while they act like cars, buses and auto-rickshaws.
cards.hi: Traffic police baniye: haathon se group ko direct kariye, aur sab car, bus aur auto-rickshaw ki acting karein.

cards.en: Make a paper boat or paper hat in 60 seconds, then show it off proudly.
cards.hi: 60 second mein kaagaz ki naav ya topi banaiye, phir shaan se sabko dikhaiye.

cards.en: Dance like a goat who has been invited to a big wedding.
cards.hi: Aise naachiye jaise ek bakri ko kisi badi shaadi mein bulaya gaya ho.

cards.en: Make the sounds of three things at home, like a fan, a door and a mixer; the group guesses each one.
cards.hi: Ghar ki teen cheezon ki awaaz nikaaliye, jaise pankha, darwaza aur mixer; group har ek guess karega.

cards.en: Play rock, paper, scissors with a willing player, shouting an animal name with every throw.
cards.hi: Kisi willing player ke saath stone, paper, scissors kheliye, aur har baar zor se ek janwar ka naam boliye.

cards.en: Draw a funny animal using only circles in 30 seconds, then give it a name.
cards.hi: 30 second mein sirf circles se ek funny janwar banaiye, phir uska naam rakhiye.

cards.en: Crumple a paper into a ball and try to throw it into a bin from three steps away.
cards.hi: Ek kaagaz ko gol karke ball banaiye aur teen kadam door se use dustbin mein daalne ki koshish kariye.

cards.en: Give a 20-second speech on why pets should be allowed in every classroom.
cards.hi: 20 second ki speech dijiye ki har classroom mein pets ko aane ki permission kyun honi chahiye.

cards.en: Sing 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star' like a grand opera singer.
cards.hi: 'Twinkle Twinkle' ya 'Machhli jal ki rani hai' ko ek bade opera singer ki tarah gaaiye.

cards.en: Play an invisible musical instrument with full energy; the group guesses which instrument it is.
cards.hi: Poore josh se ek invisible instrument bajaiye; group guess karega ki kaunsa instrument hai.

cards.en: Get everyone to do a stadium wave, like fans at a cricket match, around the group twice.
cards.hi: Sabse ek stadium wave karwaiye, bilkul cricket match ke fans ki tarah, poore group mein do baar.

cards.en: Would you rather go to school on a flying bus, or have your classroom under the sea?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: udne wali bus se school jaana, ya samundar ke neeche classroom?

cards.en: Would you rather have a bedroom that tidies itself, or a notebook that finishes your homework?
cards.hi: Kya behtar hai: apne aap saaf hone wala kamra, ya apne aap homework karne wali notebook?

cards.en: Never have I ever tried to count all the stars in the sky.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi aasmaan ke saare taare ginne ki koshish nahi ki.

cards.en: Never have I ever given a toy a full name and its own birthday.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi kisi khilone ka poora naam aur uska apna birthday nahi rakha.

cards.en: Who is most likely to remember everyone's birthday without being reminded?
cards.hi: Kiske bina yaad dilaye sabka birthday yaad rakhne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to make friends with every animal they meet?
cards.hi: Kiske har milne wale janwar se dosti karne ke chances sabse zyada hain?
